source.name: 433FC – Saudi Pro League 2026/27 Shirt Sponsors (table: Main Shirt Sponsor / Kit Manufacturer)
source.note: Row of the page's league-wide table, column 'Main Shirt Sponsor'. The page says its details 'reflect confirmed 2025/26 contracts carrying into 2026/27'; Kammelna was Al-Ettifaq's front sponsor since 2022. Its kit-maker cell (Castore) is superseded by the Jako launch below. The white Kammelna (كملنا) wordmark sits centre chest on the match shirt in the SPL's own 2026-27 derby photos.

source.name: Saudi Pro League – Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL (Al Ettifaq Home 26-27 photo)
source.note: Official league gallery. Tameeni is also a current club partner in the sponsor strip on ettifaq.com.

source.name: Ettifaq Club (official site): 'الاتفاق يدشن أطقم الموسم.. ويوقع عقود رعاية جديدة' (club signs new sponsorship deals at season-kit launch)
source.quote: انضمت مستشفى المواساة كشريك طبي للنادي، فيما أصبحت شركة اكسبلير راعياً تقنياً للفريق
source.note: Translation: 'Mouwasat Hospital joined as the club's medical partner, while Xplere Company became the team's technical sponsor'. The club said the deals run 'لمدة موسم رياضي كامل' (one full sports season, i.e. 2025/26); Mouwasat is still in the club's partner strip on ettifaq.com (checked October 2026). No 2026/27 shirt placement verified, so kept as 'partner'.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Al-Ettifaq 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: Saudi Pro League side Al-Ettifaq have officially unveiled their new home and away kits, made by Jako
source.note: Kit supplier for 2026/27; the official SPL kit gallery photo and match photos show Jako branding on the home shirt. Jako replaces Castore (2025/26 maker).

summary: Jako home kit (launched 13 August 2026). Kammelna front-centre, Tameeni right chest, Qaid and Enterprise on the sleeves; Mouwasat is the club's medical partner. Back, shorts and other placements not yet verified against a photo or announcement, so the list is not complete.
